name: write_range
author: hprebar
title: Write range
description: Batch write 2D values, arrays, or formulas to a range starting at target cell. Auto-sizes destination range. Takes an automatic snapshot before writing.
notes: Uses Range.Resize and 2D array assignment in a single COM call for speed.

values.description: 2D array of rows and columns to write: [[row1_col1, row1_col2], [row2_col1, row2_col2]].

sheet.description: Target worksheet. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

isFormula.description: If true, treats string values starting with '=' as active formulas.
